scope: Read-only source inventory and public website inspection; no dependency install, upstream build, corpus import, website implementation, or benchmark campaign.

upstream_ci.node: 24 / 24.x; exact patch is not pinned in inspected workflows

constraints.theme_rule: Dark/no-blue applies to Labs report pages only; Capgo websites may use light themes and blue, and should remain Capgo-inspired.
constraints.runtime_rule: Not static-only. Downloaded projects must support users own API configuration; optional GitHub Pages preview cannot host a backend.
constraints.component_rule: Static HTML, CSS, vanilla JS first; justified independently testable framework islands allowed. No framework preselection or site-wide hydration by default.
constraints.mdx_rule: Ingest shared MD/MDX corpus with provenance; normalized maintained representation allowed and no MDX runtime/authoring requirement.
constraints.visual_rule: Close Capgo fidelity for both implementations; maintenance architecture is the primary distinction.

experiment.name: capgo-agent
experiment.maintained_representation: validated normalized semantic records with original sources retained
